# CreateOrder prices the last line of a two-line order as qty 1: a one-line order passes, so the row says the trigger
$ shrt gate -repro  [exit 1]
FAIL       orders  order_1_2 (OrderService/CreateOrder) order.total_minor want=750 got=500; suspect the write
failures by suspect rpc:
  OrderService/CreateOrder order.total_minor: 1 step(s) in 1 chain(s); e.g. orders order_1_2
    trigger: fails with lines of 2+ items (1 call); passes with lines of 1 item (1 call)
coverage: 11 rpc(s) have no contract, so no planned probes (boundaries, other roles, missing tokens, read-backs); shrt contract init -all, then shrt contract plan -all -write
repro, for each row of failures by suspect rpc:
  OrderService/CreateOrder order.total_minor
    repro: shrt run .shrt/scratch/orders-slice-order_1_2.yaml  (reproduced 3/3)
masks: no chain here has a safe spot, so verify masked nothing

# with a second failing two-line order and a one-line order of qty 2, only lines of 2+ items together with a last qty above 1 split them
